overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board did not deliberate after adjourning its January 10, 2023 meeting, and the complaint was resolved by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged two of three members deliberated after the January 10 meeting adjourned, while remaining in the meeting room.
allegations.key_passage: Absent specific evidence to the contrary, we credit the public body’s version of events that it did not deliberate outside of the January 10 meeting.
